safety.title: Write protection
safety.description:
**{stove_name}**

Permanently stored settings, such as schedules or setpoints, use EEPROM memory. Frequent writes can wear it out. Reading and RAM controls remain available.

Recommended: at most 15 writes in 60 minutes and 50 in 24 hours. Counts survive restarts.

data_description.allow_eeprom_writes: Off: EEPROM changes are blocked for this stove.

mqtt_client.title: Direct MQTT client
mqtt_client.description: For {stove_name}. Username: {username}. Use a client ID starting with navel-user-. Allow only a trusted LAN client. MQTT is unencrypted. Use at least 16 characters; leave the password blank to keep it. Disabling access removes its credentials.
